intro.text: Every clock in town stopped at the same second, then began ticking in different directions. The source is an old Deepworks machine chapel where a master engineer is rebuilding time out of broken gears.

outro.text: With the third gear-scarab destroyed, the machine loses its rhythm. The Master of Broken Gears keeps moving for a few furious seconds, then all his tools fall at once.

storyTriggers.title: Clock-In Cage
storyTriggers.text: Punch cards hang from hooks, all stamped THIRD SHIFT. None have a leaving time.

storyTriggers.title: Counting Floor
storyTriggers.text: Gears roll in grooves across the floor and count your steps aloud in a language of clicks.

storyTriggers.title: First Gear Broken
storyTriggers.text: The first scarab cracks open. The ticking in the walls skips a beat.

storyTriggers.title: Third Gear Broken
storyTriggers.text: The third scarab breaks. Far ahead, the machine chapel door unlocks with a disappointed chime.

storyTriggers.title: Machine Chapel
storyTriggers.text: The Master of Broken Gears turns, offended that time itself has failed to keep you out.

designNotes.specialLocks: Machine chapel uses a phrase lock answer hinted by room story.
designNotes.revision: Expanded to seven rooms and roughly 5-8 encounter rooms; hidden doors are one-sided from reachable rooms only.
